title: How to check a Gambling Commission licence in four steps

scenes.say: Every betting and casino site that takes customers in Great Britain needs a licence from the Gambling Commission. Checking one takes about two minutes.
scenes.caption: Every betting and casino site that takes customers in Great Britain needs a licence from the Gambling Commission. Checking one takes about two minutes.

visual.kicker: Check a licence in four steps
visual.title: Is this site licensed in Great Britain?

scenes.say: Step one: scroll to the bottom of the site. A licensed operator names the company behind it and gives its Gambling Commission account number.
scenes.caption: Step 1: scroll to the bottom of the site. A licensed operator names the company behind it and gives its Gambling Commission account number.

scenes.say: Step two: open the Gambling Commission's public register, and search for that number or the company's name.
scenes.caption: Step 2: open the Gambling Commission's public register, and search for that number or the company's name.

scenes.say: Step three: check the licence is active, and for the right kind of gambling: betting for a bookmaker, casino for a casino.
scenes.caption: Step 3: check the licence is active, and for the right kind of gambling: betting for a bookmaker, casino for a casino.

scenes.say: Step four: check the site is really theirs. The register lists the web addresses each licensee uses, and the site you're on should be one of them.
scenes.caption: Step 4: check the site is really theirs. The register lists the web addresses each licensee uses, and the site you're on should be one of them.

visual.heading: The site's address is on the licence

scenes.say: Watch for red flags: no account number, or one that leads to a different company. Only a licence from somewhere else. No deposit limits and no mention of GAMSTOP. If you see them, don't sign up.
scenes.caption: Watch for red flags: no account number, or one that leads to a different company. Only a licence from somewhere else. No deposit limits and no mention of GAMSTOP. If you see them, don't sign up.

Only a licence from somewhere else
